game.name: Fruit Reach
game.description: A reaching activity where the patient moves the tracked hand toward fruit targets appearing at different screen positions. The activity combines upper-limb movement, visual scanning and reaction time while keeping therapist control over target placement and difficulty.
game.theme: Clean colorful fruit market with limited visual clutter

gameplay.mechanics: Fruit targets appear one at a time or in small groups at configurable normalized positions. The patient moves the tracked hand toward the active target and holds inside the target zone long enough to validate the reach. Successful targets disappear and the next target is presented.
gameplay.completionCondition: Complete 20 successful reaches or finish the configured session duration.
gameplay.errorBehavior: Use neutral visual feedback if the target is missed. Do not punish or reset progress. Continue with the next attempt according to therapist settings.
